trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied dot-path selectors (update operator keys, pipeline stage field names, query selectors) are trusted as plain data paths; nothing decides whether a path segment may reach Object.prototype before walk() assigns or resolve()/resolveGraph() read through it.

landing_point.why: Summary names the Update API / updateMany; updateMany -> updateDocuments -> buildParams (src/updater.ts:346-352) is where update selectors are first parsed, and the fix's own update check lands there.

fix_sites.entry_point: updateMany/updateOne/update (src/index.ts:84-130) and the exported update operators ($set, $inc, ... via walkExpression at src/operators/update/_internal.ts:137)

walk(): reached by every update operator via applyUpdate (src/operators/update/_internal.ts:78), and by setValue/removeValue from aggregate()/updateMany pipeline stages $addFields/$set/$project/$unwind/$graphLookup (src/operators/pipeline/addFields.ts:26, src/operators/pipeline/project.ts:94)
resolve(): Query/find selectors, positional update path (src/operators/update/_internal.ts:81), exported util resolve (src/util/index.ts:31)
getValue() under resolve/resolveGraph: any find()/aggregate() field path

fix_sites.module_kind: query predicate (refactor: drops pre-split pathArray so resolve's own check sees the selector)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/util/_internal.ts:658 (walk, behind exported setValue/removeValue src/util/index.ts:30-32) and src/util/_internal.ts:508/569 (resolve/resolveGraph, plus query-side callers src/operators/_predicates.ts:66 and src/operators/query/element/exists.ts:12-17)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about updateMany, so a solver validates keys in buildParams and argues that aggregation pipeline stages ($addFields/$project via setValue) and read-only query resolution are a different feature; for 'constructor.prototype' they argue only '__proto__' was reported.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Documents may legitimately own keys named like Object.prototype members (e.g. 'constructor', 'toString', 'valueOf') and keys that merely contain the text '__proto__' (e.g. 'my__proto__x'); the fix's tests require resolve({a:{[prop]:'value'}}, 'a.'+prop) to still return 'value'. A substring ban or a blanket ban on 'constructor' breaks these; $-prefixed positional segments ('$', '$[]', '$[id]') inside update paths must keep working while a top-level '$' prefix is rejected.

O6_input_shapes: Object.prototype member names on read via getValue (intended; see unverified)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Update/pipeline selector 'constructor.prototype.<x>': walk() follows obj['constructor'] to Object, then 'prototype' to Object.prototype, and isObject(Object.prototype) is true, so the leaf write lands on Object.prototype; assertNoProto only matches '__proto__' and walk does not use getValue.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory and fix tests only mention '__proto__'; 'constructor' is a legitimate document key a solver is told must keep resolving.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the util-level fix (src/util/_internal.ts), one file away from the update landing point; reached from src/operators/update/set.ts:18-27 and src/operators/pipeline/addFields.ts:26

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Read side 'constructor'/'toString' etc. via getValue: the fix intends to block unowned Object.prototype members, but OBJECT_PROTO_PROPS is built from .find() (a single string), so the Set holds characters and does not block those names.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only lookup with no write into a shared prototype; solver can call it 'unexpected results', not pollution.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as walk; reached from find()/aggregate() selectors

O8b_injection_room.sibling: $setField writes an arbitrary caller 'field' key onto a fresh object; a dotted-path variant via setValue would be a realistic deep-write sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainer could plausibly 'support nested field names' by switching newObj[field]=value to setValue(newObj, field, value).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mergeInto recursively copies keys from resolved graphs onto the target with out[k]=...; a variant that merges caller-supplied objects (e.g. $mergeObjects deep mode) would be a merge-route sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Recursive merge helpers are a common feature request; mergeInto already exists and uses Object.keys without a key filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: arrayFilters keys grouped by root into res[parent][k]; a nested-object grouping would be a realistic set-by-path sibling outside buildParams' selector loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Filter grouping is separate code from selector validation and a maintainer could extend it to nested identifiers.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject selectors containing '__proto__' in buildParams only (update operators), leaving pipeline-stage setValue, constructor.prototype, and the low-level walk open.

out_of_scope_notes: cloneDeep (src/util/_internal.ts:366) and update clone 'copy' mode Object.assign (src/operators/update/_internal.ts:39) copy an own '__proto__' key from JSON-parsed values, changing only the new object's prototype; not pursued.
$setField (src/operators/expression/object/setField.ts:39) with field '__proto__' replaces the result object's prototype locally; not pursued.
